verdict.rationale: A state commission's public web presence could plausibly publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of either. The only relevant signal is that both www.scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov serve robots.txt with "Disallow: /" for all agents, so nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched. Confidence is medium because llms.txt was never directly checked.
